Company intelligence

Mature — 15 years on record

Artarna Multi Trading Private Limited is a mature company that has operated through multiple regulatory regimes including the Companies Act 2013 transition. Based on its MCA incorporation date, the company has been on the Indian corporate register for 15 years, which places it in the mature bracket used in CorpIntel's age analysis.

Small-capital capital structure

With a paid-up capital of ₹5,00,000, Artarna Multi Trading Private Limited falls into the small-capital band (₹1 lakh–₹10 lakh) — between ₹1 lakh and ₹10 lakh — the dominant band for most Indian private limited companies. The authorised and paid-up capital are equal, meaning the company has fully utilised its share-issuance headroom.

Corporate classification

Artarna Multi Trading Private Limited is registered as a company limited by shares, meaning shareholder liability is capped at the unpaid amount on the shares they hold — by far the most common corporate form in India. A private limited company cannot freely issue shares to the public and has restrictions on share transferability — the default form for most Indian startups, SMEs, and closely-held businesses.

Status: Active

An Active status on the MCA register means the company has not been struck off, amalgamated, dissolved, or marked for action. It does not by itself confirm ongoing operations or financial health — it only reflects the company's compliance standing on the MCA master data.

Regulatory jurisdiction

The ROC Mumbai is the Registrar of Companies office responsible for administering incorporations, filings, and statutory compliance for this company under the Companies Act 2013. Every Indian company is assigned a single ROC based on the location of its registered office, and all annual returns, director appointments, and capital changes must be filed with that jurisdiction.

Terms on this page

Every field on this record has a filed definition. The terms below explain the acronyms and fields you see above.

  • Corporate Identification Number

    The 21-character alphanumeric code assigned to every Indian company at incorporation.

  • Registrar of Companies

    The statutory authority for company registration and filings under the Companies Act 2013.

  • National Industrial Classification

    India's 5-digit hierarchical classification of economic activities, maintained by MoSPI.

  • Paid-up Capital

    The amount of share capital actually subscribed and paid by shareholders.

  • Authorised Capital

    The maximum share capital a company is legally permitted to issue.

  • Ministry of Corporate Affairs

    The Government of India ministry that regulates Indian corporate law and company filings.
